notes.title: Update v498 - Changelog
notes.content:
- Changed default difficulty level on startup to Easy.
- Added command line argument -Difficulty [difficulty_level] options are: easy, normal, and hard.
- Added command line argument -ArcadeMode, which will reset the level when the player dies, instead of loading the lobby.

These arguments can be used as launch options in the game's properties in Steam.
